MANCHESTER CITY YAS RESIDENCES — PHASE 2 | Ohana
Yas Canal, Abu Dhabi

Broker intelligence: a 15 September sales briefing points to an October release, with approximately 600 homes: 2–3BR + maid townhouses and 4–5BR standalone villas.

The briefing indicates an AVERAGE AED 3.8m for 2BR townhouses — not a starting price. An expected 40/60 plan and Q4 2029 handover remain provisional, subject to final confirmation.

A phase-specific opportunity to prepare for ahead of the confirmed release.

ALHAMBRA AT BLOOM LIVING | Bloom Holding
Zayed City, Abu Dhabi

Studios–3BR apartments, 3BR townhouses and limited 4BR penthouses. Announced starting price: AED 865,000; current availability requires confirmation.

Final booking terms remain to be verified. The planned Souk Alhambra retail and services centre adds interest for family and rental buyers.
